name: Platform Brawl
hook: Knock your rivals off the stage.
how: Every hit raises the other fighter's damage, and the higher it is, the farther they fly. Fall off three times and you are out. Last one on the stage wins.
controls: Arrow keys with Z and X, or on-screen buttons
uses: The players with the most match wins.
The host's browser counts stocks, calls the winner and starts the next match; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill the stage and fight back until enough people join.
Every jump, hit and launch shows up for everyone at once.
ideas: Add items that drop from the sky
Add a stage with moving platforms
Add a character with a double jump
